goal: migrate.sh rewrites a v1 record file to the v2 format. v1 lines are `key=value`; v2 lines are `key:value`. Only the FIRST `=` separates the key from the value, so a value may itself contain `=` characters, and lines that already contain `:` are v2 and must be left byte-identical. The current script corrupts values containing `=`. Fix it and make it idempotent: running it twice must not change the file further.
